hero.title: Manage every customer camera from one place.
hero.subtitle: Keep the cameras already installed. Run the Community Core on your own infrastructure or use the managed Commercial edition. The same open plugin system connects your AI and storage in both.
hero.noCard: Community: unlimited self-hosted · Cloud: {freeCameras} cameras free · Existing ONVIF / RTSP cameras
proof.alerts: issues surfaced before a customer calls
section.problem.title: Turn reactive CCTV maintenance into a managed service.
feature.health.title: Fleet health
feature.health.body: See offline cameras, unstable streams, low bitrate and recording gaps across every customer.
feature.remote.title: Remote access
feature.remote.body: Outbound-only gateway. No inbound ports, no per-site VPN project and no camera replacement.
feature.multi.title: Multi-tenant by design
feature.multi.body: Customers → sites → gateways → cameras, ready for reseller and white-label workflows.
feature.brand.title: Your brand, your language
feature.brand.body: Logo, product name, palette, locale files and custom CSS are runtime configuration — not forks.
how.title: From Docker command to first camera.
how.one.title: Install gateway
how.one.body: Run one container or system service inside the customer LAN.
how.two.title: Discover cameras
how.two.body: ONVIF discovery and RTSP profiles are normalized at the edge.
how.three.title: Operate remotely
how.three.body: Health, incidents and on-demand live sessions appear in the cloud dashboard.
pricing.title: Open source when you want control. Commercial when you want us to operate it.
pricing.free.title: Free
pricing.free.body: For installers evaluating the platform on real equipment.
pricing.free.items: {freeCameras} cameras|1 site|Live view|Current health|24h incident history|No credit card
pricing.pro.title: Pro
pricing.pro.body: For an installer operating customer fleets.
pricing.pro.items: Unlimited sites|Alerts|Longer history|Remote access|Customer accounts|API & webhooks
pricing.rec.title: Recording & AI
pricing.rec.body: Pay only where storage or inference creates value.
security.title: The customer LAN never needs an open inbound port.
security.body: The target architecture uses outbound connections, per-gateway identity, tenant isolation, encrypted secrets and a complete audit trail.
cta.title: Make the first {freeCameras} cameras boringly easy.
cta.body: The prototype is built around self-service onboarding first; assisted 20-camera pilots come after product fit is visible.

plugins.title: AI and storage are plugins, not lock-in.
plugins.body: The Community Core and Commercial edition share one versioned plugin protocol. Keep inference close to your GPU, store video in your own S3/MinIO/B2, or connect a partner service without forking the VMS.
plugins.ai.title: Your AI
plugins.ai.body: Connect a Python/CUDA/TensorRT service or any HTTP model behind the AI adapter. Results are normalized into detections and metadata.
plugins.storage.title: Your storage
plugins.storage.body: Use S3-compatible storage via presigned transfers so video flows directly between gateway/browser and storage instead of through the control API.
plugins.open.title: Language agnostic
plugins.open.body: Plugins are isolated HTTP services. Write them in Rust, Python, Go, Node or whatever fits the workload.
plugins.same.title: Same SDK in both editions
plugins.same.body: Plugins are part of the open-source core. Commercial licensing never blocks custom AI or storage connectors.
pricing.community.title: Community Core
pricing.community.body: Run the core on your own Linux/Docker infrastructure. No hosted camera cap.
pricing.community.items: Unlimited cameras in self-hosted core|ONVIF + RTSP health|AI and storage plugin SDK|Local/S3-compatible storage plugins|Community updates
pricing.cloud.title: Cloud
pricing.cloud.body: We operate the control plane and upgrades. Start free, then pay as the managed fleet grows.
pricing.cloud.items: Managed hosting and upgrades|First {freeCameras} cameras free|Same AI/storage plugins|Remote fleet operations|Commercial support
pricing.enterprise.title: Enterprise / Reseller
pricing.enterprise.body: For integrators, distributors and security groups that need a branded, multi-tenant product.
pricing.enterprise.items: Reseller hierarchy and multi-tenancy|Advanced white-label|SSO, audit and HA|Billing/entitlements|SLA and priority support
